name: qkd_astk_ctl_s

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every data pin: cal/st/aq/am/xi/zi/fz land in (* keep *) pin flops (cal_q, st_q, aq_q, am_q, xq, zq, fz_q) and lt/ap/af/qo are registers (qkd_astk_ctl_s, rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/qkd_astk_static_leaves.sv)

fill_reason.pin_bound: 1,653 signal pins (aq 540, qo 572, xi+zi+fz 406, W 137) with every port on one face: qo needs >= 95 um and aq >= 90 um at <= 6 pins/um, so the N/S faces set the width (103.68 um: 5.6 / 5.4 pins/um) and the E face (406 pins, 4.9/um) sets the height (86.4 um); the std-cell area (~2.2k um2, old ctl 2.46k with lanes) fills ~25%. This square-ish cut replaces the 324 x 43.2 long-thin predecessor (util 20%).

slot_change_request: S-KVASTK 2026-10-18: lane-free static ASTK controller qkd_astk_ctl_s (successor of qkd_astk_ctl / _tp8, no P.V lanes px/py/fx/fy/co): hub command aq on N, the strip command bus qo on S toward the ep chain head, the return/x chain xi + Z chain zi + fz on E, hub sideband ap/am/lt/af + calendar cal + st on W. 103.68 x 86.4 instead of 324 x 43.2 (long-thin). Die lead re-cuts ASTK_W.

job.purpose: S-KVASTK: lane-free static ASTK controller qkd_astk_ctl_s of qkd_astk_strip_st: calendar-driven LMAX / Z schedule (cal from the compiler), 43-b hub sideband ap, no P.V lanes / credits; every pin registered in RTL.
